combinations.description: The Bazaar ally arrives at the Kitchen, ready to search the archives.
The Scout and Tongue of Babel work together — trade routes established.
The Artificer books all performers with royal authority.
The Chronicler presents fair evidence under the Code — both nobles accept.
Wrong: Wave a Bazaar Token at the recipe shelves. You need an ALLY, not a token. -3 min
Wrong: The Chronicler blurts out Lord Ashford's private debts! Configure the Code of Honor FIRST! -3 min
